translations.web: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.
translations.bsb: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple. A stairway led up to the middle level, and from there to the third floor.
translations.kjv: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
translations.asv: The door for the middle side-chambers was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle story, and out of the middle into the third.
